title: Pomodoro Timer
description: A focus/break timer on the matrix, controlled over MQTT or Home Assistant.

work_minutes.title: Work Session (minutes)
work_minutes.description: Length of a focus session. Also settable at runtime from Home Assistant.

short_break_minutes.title: Short Break (minutes)
short_break_minutes.description: Break taken after each work session.

long_break_minutes.title: Long Break (minutes)
long_break_minutes.description: Longer break taken after a full set of work sessions.

sessions_before_long_break.title: Sessions Before Long Break
sessions_before_long_break.description: How many work sessions make up one set. Shown on screen as the row of session dots.

auto_start_breaks.title: Auto-Start Breaks
auto_start_breaks.description: Start the break automatically when a work session ends. Turn this off to make the break wait for a Start/Resume command.

auto_start_work.title: Auto-Start Next Work Session
auto_start_work.description: Start the next work session automatically when a break ends. Off by default so you decide when to get back to it.

auto_start_on_enable.title: Start Timer When Plugin Is Enabled
auto_start_on_enable.description: Begin a work session as soon as the plugin loads. Useful if you don't use MQTT.

mqtt_enabled.title: Enable MQTT Control
mqtt_enabled.description: Connect to an MQTT broker so the timer can be driven from Home Assistant or any MQTT client. Turn off to run the timer purely from this configuration.

mqtt_host.title: Broker Address
mqtt_host.description: Hostname or IP of your MQTT broker — usually the same address as your Home Assistant instance.

mqtt_username.title: Username
mqtt_username.description: MQTT broker username. Leave blank if your broker does not require authentication.

mqtt_password.title: Password
mqtt_password.description: MQTT broker password. Leave blank if your broker does not require authentication.

command_topic.title: Command Topic
command_topic.description: The plugin subscribes here. Publish START, PAUSE, RESUME, TOGGLE, SKIP, STOP or RESET — or JSON for per-message durations and labels. Every other topic is derived from this one.

state_topic.title: State Topic
state_topic.description: The plugin publishes ON (a session is active) or OFF (idle) here so the Home Assistant switch stays in sync.

ha_discovery.title: Enable Home Assistant Auto-Discovery
ha_discovery.description: Announce the timer to Home Assistant over MQTT. HA creates a device with the switch, start/pause/skip/reset buttons, duration number boxes, and phase/remaining sensors — no configuration.yaml entry needed.

discovery_prefix.title: HA Discovery Prefix
discovery_prefix.description: The MQTT topic prefix your HA MQTT integration listens on. Leave as 'homeassistant' unless you changed it in HA.

device_name.title: Device Name in Home Assistant
device_name.description: How this device appears under Settings → Devices & Services → MQTT in Home Assistant.

publish_interval_seconds.title: State Publish Interval (seconds)
publish_interval_seconds.description: How often the countdown is published while running. Raise this to cut broker traffic; state changes (start, pause, phase change) are always published immediately.

color_mode.title: Countdown Color
color_mode.description: 'phase' colors the countdown by what's running (work / break / long break / paused). 'fixed' always uses the Countdown Text Color below.

time_color.title: Countdown Text Color
time_color.description: Used only when Countdown Color is set to 'fixed'.

show_phase_label.title: Show Phase Label
show_phase_label.description: Show the current phase name above the countdown.

show_session_dots.title: Show Session Dots
show_session_dots.description: Show one dot per work session in the set, filled in as you complete them.

idle_label.title: Idle Label
idle_label.description: Shown when no timer is running, above the next work session's length.

paused_label.title: Paused Label
paused_label.description: Shown in place of the phase name while the timer is paused. Leave blank to keep showing the phase name.

font_path.title: Font
font_path.description: Path to a TTF font file relative to the LEDMatrix root, e.g. assets/fonts/PressStart2P-Regular.ttf. Leave blank to use the display's default font.

font_size.title: Font Size (px)
font_size.description: Fix the countdown font height in pixels. Leave at 0 to size the countdown automatically to the panel.

pin_while_running.title: Hold the Display While Running
pin_while_running.description: Take over the matrix for as long as a session is active, instead of rotating through your other plugins. Turn off to let the timer take its normal turn in the rotation.

alert_seconds.title: Phase-Change Alert (seconds)
alert_seconds.description: How long the timer grabs the display when a phase ends. Set to 0 to disable the alert.

alert_flash.title: Flash on Phase Change
alert_flash.description: Flash the panel during the phase-change alert.

display_duration.title: Display Duration (seconds)
display_duration.description: How long the timer stays on screen each rotation cycle when it isn't holding the display.

digit_style.title: Countdown Digits
digit_style.description: 'seven_segment' draws the countdown as clock-radio style segments sized to the panel. 'pixel' uses the display's pixel font.

show_ghost_segments.title: Show Unlit Segments
show_ghost_segments.description: Show the unlit segments faintly, the way a real LED clock shows its dark segments. It looks authentic but costs legibility — every digit gains a faint 8 behind it — so it is off by default. Ignored when the stroke is only one pixel wide.

progress_style.title: Burndown Indicator
progress_style.description: How the time left in the phase is shown. 'perimeter' drains a ring around the edge of the panel and leaves the most room for the digits; 'bar' empties a bar along the bottom; 'segments' puts out a row of blocks one at a time; 'none' hides it.
